response.sql: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account a INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), regional_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_count) as region_avg_count FROM account_counts GROUP BY region), above_average_districts AS (SELECT ac.district_id, ac.region, ac.account_count, ac.account_count - ra.region_avg_count as exceeds_region_avg FROM account_counts ac INNER JOIN regional_averages ra ON ac.region = ra.region WHERE ac.account_count > ra.region_avg_count), global_average AS (SELECT AVG(account_count) as global_avg FROM above_average_districts), with_ratios AS (SELECT aad.district_id, aad.region, aad.account_count, aad.exceeds_region_avg, aad.account_count / ga.global_avg as ratio FROM above_average_districts aad CROSS JOIN global_average ga) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, exceeds_region_avg, ratio FROM with_ratios WHERE ratio >= (SELECT MIN(ratio) FROM (SELECT ratio FROM with_ratios ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10) AS tenth_largest) ORDER BY ratio DESC
